our_title: ltleaf permutation size and duplicates unchecked in release; mismatches read out of bounds
ran: cd repro/common; ./archload 'ltleaf 1 4 1 4 0 0 1 2' -> load ret=0 name=ltleaf size=4 (duplicate accepted); gmap -vm m4x4.grf on it -> 'M\tProcessors 3/4 (0.75)' (terminal lost; peritab[3] never written). ./archload 'ltleaf 1 4 1 3 2 1 0' -> load ret=0; gmap -vm -> 'AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4 #0 _SCOTCHarchTleafDomDist arch_tleaf.c:497 #1 graphMapView2' (4 bytes before the sizetab region). ./archbuild 1 (SCOTCH_archLtleaf with duplicate indices) -> r=0 then 'heap-buffer-overflow READ #0 _SCOTCHarchLtleafDomNum arch_tleaf.c:801' when the uninitialised peritab slot is used. Patched: the three inputs are rejected ('archLtleafArchBuild2: duplicate permutation index' / 'permutation size does not match level boundaries'), valid files ('ltleaf 3 32 10 2 5 4 1 8 0 2 4 6 1 3 5 7', 'ltleaf 2 2 1 2 1 1 0', 'ltleaf 2 2 1 2 1 4 3 2 1 0') load as before. Series exported with format-patch and re-applied with git am on a fresh v7.0.17 clone after G01's five patches.
severity_note: User target file; out-of-bounds read (mismatched size) or silently wrong mapping (duplicate); same as the review.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/arch_tleaf.c:692-705 (level-boundary check under SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2), 712-730 (duplicate check under SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2), 733-735 (inverse permutation), 799-801 and 828-831 (uses)
evidence: arch_tleaf.c:692 '#ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2' ... :697-698 'for (levlnum = archptr->levlnbr - 1, sizeval = archptr->sizetab[levlnum]; sizeval != archptr->permnbr; levlnum --, sizeval *= archptr->sizetab[levlnum]) { if (levlnum < 0) {' (increment indexes sizetab[-1] before the test); :723-730 duplicate loop under SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2; :735 'archptr->peritab[archptr->permtab[permnum]] = permnum;' leaves slots unwritten on duplicates.
review_accuracy: Accurate on mechanism and fix. Its exact string 'ltleaf 1 4 1 4 0 0 1 2' gives an uninitialised peritab slot, which reads out of bounds at line 801 only when the garbage value makes the modulo negative (seen through SCOTCH_archLtleaf under ASan, not through gmap, where the symptom is a lost terminal); the mismatched-size variant is the one that crashes deterministically (line 497).
first_pass_critique: Status, evidence and the sizetab[-1] reading are right. Its preferred option A (loader-only, O(n) marking) is correct for files but leaves SCOTCH_archLtleaf with the same holes (it addressed those separately in API-10 by duplicating the checks in library_arch.c, i.e. two copies of the same validation, which is not what the tree does for cmpltw/sub). Its diff keeps `peritab[...] = -1` sentinels instead of the tree's ~0 idiom, and does not make archTleafArchFree tolerate a half-built body.

fix_options.label: A. Loader-only unconditional checks (first pass)
fix_options.summary: Promote both debug checks to release in archLtleafArchLoad, test levlnum before indexing, detect duplicates by marking peritab while reading.

fix_options.maintainer_fit: He would take the unconditional checks, but he keeps one implementation per class (archCmpltwArchBuild, archSubArchBuild), so a loader-only fix leaves API-10 to be fixed with a second copy.

fix_options.label: B. One shared build routine per class (recommended)

fix_options.maintainer_fit: Precedents: SCOTCH_archCmpltw() / archCmpltwArchBuild() (library_arch.c:307, arch_cmpltw.c:201) and SCOTCH_archSub() / archSubArchBuild(): library builders are thin wrappers over an archXxxArchBuild() that owns the checks and allocations; archCmpltwArchLoad2() reads into a temporary array and validates in the same routine; G01's archSub/archDist series (same discipline: loader NULLs its fields, Build publishes only on success, Free tolerates an empty body); d555f2c (archLoad frees through the class hook on failure); 'bad input (n)' / 'invalid ...' error strings and unconditional checks for user-controlled data as in c5baef9.

cleanup_done: Removed the two SCOTCH_DEBUG_ARCH2 blocks and the permtmp variable they used; removed the separate inverse-permutation loop; removed SCOTCH_archTleaf/Ltleaf's local copies of the allocation code and their tgtarchdatptr/levlnum/sizeval/permnum locals; the debug-only NULLing in archTleafArchFree became unconditional (no dead #ifdef left).
test_added: src/check/test_scotch_arch.c: an ltleaf architecture whose 12-entry permutation spans the two lowest levels (sizes 3 and 4) is built, saved, reloaded and sub-architected like the others (ARCHNBR 27 -> 29). No negative test: no test_*.c in src/check exercises error paths.
notes: Design note for the maintainer: validation of user-controlled architecture data is now unconditional in the Build routines, exactly as archCmpltwArchBuild2 and the G01 archSub series do; the loaders free nothing of the body on failure (archLoad does, through the class hook, as d555f2c relies on).

our_title: Failed ltleaf build leaks its tree part and leaves a half-built architecture
ran: Plain (non-sanitized) trees, FAILMALLOC=n MALLOC_CHECK_=3 LD_PRELOAD=./failmalloc.so ./archbuild_plainpristine 9|10: n=1 -> 'SCOTCH_archTleaf: out of memory' r=1 'exit ok'; n=2 (mode 9) -> 'SCOTCH_archLtleaf: out of memory' r=1 'exit ok' (SCOTCH_archExit after the failure neither crashes nor double-frees: the failed memAlloc stored NULL in the field it assigned). Patched: n=1 -> 'archTleafArchBuild: out of memory'; n=2 -> 'archLtleafArchBuild2: out of memory', then exit ok.
read_only: The leak itself (sizetab left allocated after SCOTCH_archLtleaf's permtab allocation fails, when the caller does not call SCOTCH_archExit on a failed build) was established from library_arch.c:546-555 and archTleafArchFree; LeakSanitizer cannot be combined with the malloc-failure preload (ASan owns malloc).
severity_note: Lower than the first pass's 'low': its stated mechanism (archExit on indeterminate pointers) does not happen; what remains is a leak on an allocation-failure path plus an inconsistent body, both only reachable under memory exhaustion.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/library_arch.c:505-513 (clasptr set before memAlloc), 546-555 (SCOTCH_archLtleaf overrides the class and fails without freeing sizetab)
evidence: library_arch.c:550 'tgtarchptr->clasptr = archClass ("ltleaf");     /* Override class */' then :552-555 'if ((tgtarchdatptr->permtab = memAlloc (...)) == NULL) { errorPrint (...); return (1); }' with sizetab still allocated.
review_accuracy: Not in the review (first-pass finding); the review's API-10 'free arrays on failure' covers it.
first_pass_critique: The claim 'A later SCOTCH_archExit then calls archTleafArchFree on indeterminate pointers' is wrong: a failed memAlloc assigns NULL to the field, so archExit is safe (shown at runtime). The real defect is the leak of sizetab when permtab fails and the caller does not archExit, plus the inconsistent body. Method 'source-read' was honest; the conclusion overstated.

fix_options.label: A. Build routines publish on success, Free empties the body (recommended)
fix_options.summary: archLtleafArchBuild frees the tree part when the permutation part fails; archTleafArchFree NULLs its fields unconditionally and tolerates NULL, so SCOTCH_archExit after any failed build is a no-op.
fix_options.tested: repro/PS-API-4 plain-tree sweep; Builds: 32-bit and 64-bit Gnum ASan+UBSan trees, 0 warnings; every touched file also compiled with -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL. Targets (both word sizes): check_scotch_arch, check_scotch_arch_deco, check_prog_atst, check_prog_amk, check_prog_amk_grf, check_prog_gmk, check_prog_gmap pass with no sanitizer output; check_scotch_arch_build and check_scotch_graph_map show only the pre-existing archDecoArchBuild2 leak and bgraph_bipart_ml.c:195 / kgraph_map_ml.c:239 null-offset UBSan (identical to pristine, other groups). Fuzzing (repro/fuzz, 2000 mutated tleaf/ltleaf/hcub/sub strings, seed 1): pristine 32-bit 29 signatures / 343 hits, 64-bit 36 / 366; with G01 + this series: 32-bit 6 / 152 (all intLoad overflow in common_integer.c:121, another group), 64-bit 3 / 47 (intLoad, plus two arch_sub.c cases listed in extra.json). Series exported with format-patch and re-applied with git am on a fresh v7.0.17 clone after G01's five patches.
fix_options.tradeoffs: archTleafArchFree does three extra stores in release builds.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: G01's archSubArchFree/archDistArchFree tolerate an unbuilt body; the maintainer guide defines Free as leaving an empty, reusable object.

fix_options.label: B. Clear the body on failure in the builders
fix_options.summary: memFree the tree part and memSet the Arch to zero in SCOTCH_archTleaf/Ltleaf failure paths.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Keeps the builder-side duplication; archLoad's failure idiom (memSet of the body) applied to builders.

our_title: amk/gmk generators shift int 1 by an unbounded dimension
ran: Pristine, both trees (UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=0, timeout 5 bin/<tool> <dim> >/dev/null): amk_hy 30 -> 'amk_hy.c:150:13: left shift of 1 by 31 places', amk_hy 40 -> 'amk_hy.c:149:13: shift exponent 40 is too large for 32-bit type int'; gmk_hy 31 -> gmk_hy.c:146:12; gmk_hy 27 (32-bit) -> 'gmk_hy.c:151:31: signed integer overflow: 27 * 134217728'; gmk_ub2 31 -> :164:13, gmk_ub2 29 (32-bit) -> ':169:28: 536870912 * 4'; amk_fft2 15 (32-bit) -> ':171:11: left shift of 1073741824 by 1', amk_fft2 31 (64-bit) -> ':171:11: left shift of 4611686018427387904 by 1' in long; amk_ccc 31 -> :157-159. Patched: 32-bit accepts/rejects at amk_hy 29/30, gmk_hy 25/26, gmk_ub2 28/29, amk_fft2 14/15, amk_ccc 24/25; 64-bit at 61/62, 57/58, 60/61, 30/31, 56/57 ('main: invalid dimension'); no UBSan line on any accepted dimension (first lines before the 20 s timeout of the huge outputs); check_prog_amk / check_prog_gmk (dimension 5) pass on both trees. Builds: 32-bit and 64-bit Gnum ASan+UBSan trees, 0 warnings; every touched file also compiled with -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL. Targets (both word sizes): check_scotch_arch, check_scotch_arch_deco, check_prog_atst, check_prog_amk, check_prog_amk_grf, check_prog_gmk, check_prog_gmap pass with no sanitizer output; check_scotch_arch_build and check_scotch_graph_map show only the pre-existing archDecoArchBuild2 leak and bgraph_bipart_ml.c:195 / kgraph_map_ml.c:239 null-offset UBSan (identical to pristine, other groups). Fuzzing (repro/fuzz, 2000 mutated tleaf/ltleaf/hcub/sub strings, seed 1): pristine 32-bit 29 signatures / 343 hits, 64-bit 36 / 366; with G01 + this series: 32-bit 6 / 152 (all intLoad overflow in common_integer.c:121, another group), 64-bit 3 / 47 (intLoad, plus two arch_sub.c cases listed in extra.json). Series exported with format-patch and re-applied with git am on a fresh v7.0.17 clone after G01's five patches.
severity_note: Command-line tools; undefined arithmetic and wrong headers, but a dimension >= 15..31 means an output of gigabytes anyway. Same as the review.
evidence: amk_hy.c:120 'if ((hdim = atoi (argv[i])) < 1)' (lower bound only); :149 'hnbr =  1 << hdim;' :150 'hmax = (1 << (hdim + 1)) - 1;'; amk_fft2.c:154 'fnbr = (fdim + 1) * (1 << fdim);' :157 'fmax = (fmax << 2) | 2;' (2*fdim+1 bits); amk_ccc.c:159 'for (ccmax = ((1 << (ccdim + 1)) - 1), i = ccdim - 1;'.
review_accuracy: Accurate; its line list misses amk_fft2.c:168/180/213/222 and amk_ccc.c:204 (shifts by vertex levels, bounded by the dimension) and the products that overflow below the shift limit (gmk_hy 27, gmk_ub2 29, amk_fft2 15 on 32-bit).
first_pass_critique: Correct status and evidence, and it noticed the products. Its sketch proposes one bound 'bits - 3' for all tools, which still leaves gmk_hy 27..29, gmk_ub2 29..30 and amk_fft2 15..29 overflowing on 32-bit (it saw those overflows in its own evidence but did not derive the bounds from them).

Fuzzing (repro/fuzz, 2000 mutated tleaf/ltleaf/hcub/sub strings, seed 1): pristine 32-bit 29 signatures / 343 hits, 64-bit 36 / 366; with G01 + this series: 32-bit 6 / 152 (all intLoad overflow in common_integer.c:121, another group), 64-bit 3 / 47 (intLoad, plus two arch_sub.c cases listed in extra.json). our_title: tleaf accepts zero/negative level counts and overflows the terminal product (meshXD half is G03's)
ran: ./archload 'tleaf 0' -> load ret=0 size=1; './archload 'sub 1 0 tleaf 0' -> 'AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4 #0 _SCOTCHarchTleafMatchInit arch_tleaf.c:255 #1 _SCOTCHarchSubArchBuild arch_sub.c:414'; './archload 'tleaf -1 2 1' -> 'AddressSanitizer: requested allocation size 0xfffffffffffffffc ... #1 archTleafArchLoad arch_tleaf.c:120'; './archload 'tleaf 2 65536 1 65536 1' -> 'arch_tleaf.c:136:13: runtime error: signed integer overflow: 65536 * 65536', load ret=0 size=0; 64-bit: 'tleaf 2 3037000500 1 3037000500 1' -> overflow in long, size=-9223372036709301616. LeakSanitizer on 'tleaf 2 3 1 -1 1' (bad input (2)): no leak (archLoad frees through the class hook, d555f2c). Patched: 'tleaf 0' / 'tleaf -1 2 1' / 31 levels -> 'archTleafArchLoad2: bad input (1)'; the overflowing products -> 'archTleafArchBuild: too many terminal domains'; 30 levels of 2 (2^30) and 64-bit 3037000499^2 still load. Verification as COR-06.
severity_note: User target file; out-of-bounds read through 'sub' and silent wrong terminal count; same as the review.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/arch_tleaf.c:115-118 (levlnbr unchecked), 120 (levlnbr*2+1 allocation), 128-137 (product), 241-255 (archTleafMatchInit reads sizetab[-1] when levlnbr == 0)
evidence: arch_tleaf.c:115 'if (intLoad (stream, &archptr->levlnbr) != 1) {' (no bound); :136 'sizeval *= archptr->sizetab[levlnum];' (no overflow test); :255 'matcptr->levlsiz = sizetab[levlnnd];' with levlnnd = levlnbr - 1.
upstream_change: d555f2c made archLoad free through the class hook only when it exists; as a side effect the sizetab leak the review saw on 'bad input (2)' is gone in 7.0.17. The validation itself is unchanged.
review_accuracy: Accurate for the counts and the product; the 'sizetab leaking on bad input (2)' sub-claim no longer holds in 7.0.17 (not observable with LeakSanitizer).
first_pass_critique: Correct, including the leak observation. Its upper bound '(ANUMMAX - 1) / 2' only protects the allocation arithmetic; the real bound is bits(Anum)-2 because every level at least doubles the terminal count (the product check then makes it exact). It flagged a possible levlnbr==0 contract in library_arch_build.c: there is none (archBuild builds deco architectures, never tleaf).

extra_instances.location: src/libscotch/library_arch.c:510-524 (SCOTCH_archTleaf: same allocation and product with no check)
src/libscotch/arch_mesh.c archMeshXArchLoad (dimnnbr lower bound, product) -- G03's half

fix_options.label: A. Loader-only bounds and product check (first pass)
fix_options.summary: levlnbr in [1, (ANUMMAX-1)/2], 'sizeval > ANUMMAX / sizetab[levlnum]' before multiplying, in archTleafArchLoad.
fix_options.tested: applies, compiles; behaviour tested by the first pass
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Right checks, wrong place for half of the callers.

fix_options.label: B. Guard the consumer (archTleafMatchInit) only
fix_options.tradeoffs: Negative levlnbr still wraps the allocation; the product still overflows; every other consumer (DomSize, DomNum, DomDist) would need the same guard.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He validates at the source (loader / builder), as in c5baef9 and G01's archSubArchLoad.

fix_options.label: C. Shared archTleafArchBuild with full validation (recommended)
fix_options.summary: See COR-06 option B: levlnbr >= 1 (loader additionally bounds it by bits-2 before allocating its temporary), sizes >= 2, links >= 1, product checked against ANUMMAX.
fix_options.tradeoffs: 'tleaf 0' (a one-terminal architecture) is now refused, consistent with 'hcub 0' being refused.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Precedents: SCOTCH_archCmpltw() / archCmpltwArchBuild() (library_arch.c:307, arch_cmpltw.c:201) and SCOTCH_archSub() / archSubArchBuild(): library builders are thin wrappers over an archXxxArchBuild() that owns the checks and allocations; archCmpltwArchLoad2() reads into a temporary array and validates in the same routine; G01's archSub/archDist series (same discipline: loader NULLs its fields, Build publishes only on success, Free tolerates an empty body); d555f2c (archLoad frees through the class hook on failure); 'bad input (n)' / 'invalid ...' error strings and unconditional checks for user-controlled data as in c5baef9.

notes: Only the tree-leaf half is handled here; archMeshXArchLoad belongs to G03.
